title: Emrys and the Wolf
author: Tamsin Amberdale
blurb: Sable Okafor, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
